inputs_sent.prompt: A locked-off wide shot of a bedroom at night. The camera is fixed and never moves. A phone glows mint on the bedside table. A man lies asleep in the bed and does not move at any time. For the first second nothing happens. Then, very slowly and gradually, a double of him made of soft mint light sits up out of his sleeping body: half see-through at first, with a gentle glow inside its chest and hair-thin threads of light still joining it to the sleeper. The double looks down at the sleeper with a calm, kind face and closed lips, moves to sit on the edge of the bed and gently pulls the duvet up over the sleeper's shoulder. Then it stands up at the foot of the bed, more solid now, and looks back at the sleeper, while the last fine threads of light stretch between them. It holds still for the last second. The sleeper stays still. There are only two figures at all times: one solid and asleep, one made of light. The double keeps its soft glow and its own natural skin colour the whole time, and never looks at the camera. Slow, graceful, deliberate motion with no sudden moves. One continuous shot with no cuts, no zoom, no music, no speech, no subtitles and no text.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, locked-off wide shot of a dimly lit bedroom at night. The composition is static, capturing a centered bed where a man (S1) lies deeply asleep under a duvet. On the bedside table, a smartphone glows with a soft mint-green light. In the background, moonlight filters through sheer curtains from a window, and to the right, a simple desk and chair sit in the shadows. For the first second, the scene is perfectly still. At 00:01.000, a double of the man (S2) made of soft mint light begins to emerge and gradually sit up from S1's body. Initially, S2 is semi-transparent, with a gentle internal glow emanating from the chest and hair-thin threads of light physically connecting the ethereal figure to the sleeping S1. S2 looks down at S1 with a calm, kind facial expression and closed lips. At 00:04.500, S2 moves with slow, deliberate grace to sit on the edge of the bed. S2 reaches out and gently pulls the duvet up over S1's shoulder. At 00:07.000, S2 stands up at the foot of the bed, becoming more solid while still retaining a soft mint luminescence and natural skin tones. S2 turns back to look at the sleeping sleeper while the remaining fine threads of light stretch between them before finally dissolving. S2 stands perfectly still for the final second of the shot while S1 remains motionless in sleep.

overall_soundscape: The room is filled with the heavy silence of night, punctuated only by the soft, rhythmic rustle of fabric as the duvet is gently pulled up. A very faint, ethereal hum accompanies the emergence of the light-double, pulsing slightly in intensity as the figure becomes more solid.
